title: Measure when sparse events actually remove work
description: Change the signal, encoding, activity, and firing threshold. This synthetic workload model exposes event volume, routed synaptic work, membrane state, and saturation without claiming a universal energy advantage.

scenarios.label: Intermittent machine transient
scenarios.detail: A mostly quiet vibration stream contains one short mechanical event.

scenarios.label: Localized event-camera motion
scenarios.detail: Several moving regions create bursts separated by quieter intervals.

scenarios.label: Continuous textured motion
scenarios.detail: Most channels change repeatedly, so temporal sparsity is weak.

encoders.label: Native change events
encoders.detail: Forward only threshold-crossing changes from an event-native source.

encoders.label: Latency-coded packet
encoders.detail: Represent each detected feature with a small timed spike packet.

encoders.label: Repeated rate code
encoders.detail: Repeat spikes over a window; easier to average, but much less sparse.
